extensionDescription.message: Save an article, a selection, a whole page or a screenshot into your Brulion notebook as Markdown, with its pictures.

commandQuickClip.message: Clip the selection or the article at once

notConnectedText.message: Install Brulion's command line and connect it to your browsers once:

notConnectedDetail.message: The browser found no native messaging host for Brulion.

connectHelpMore.message: Then check again. On NixOS the module connects the browsers (programs.brulion); on Windows run brulion-cli.exe clip install.

fallbackText.message: Copy the page and paste it into a note in Brulion — on the computer, the phone or in the browser version.

placeHeading.message: Under a heading of a page

journalLinkLabel.message: Also link it from today's journal

picturesLabel.message: Save the pictures into the notebook

previewScreenshot.message: The screenshot is taken when you clip.

failedTitle.message: Brulion could not save the clip

cannotRead.message: The browser does not let extensions read this page: only a link or a screenshot can be clipped.

errorFolder.message: The folder cannot be used: no “..”, no leading “/” or “.”, no backslash.

errorNoPage.message: Choose the page with the heading.

hostError_not_connected.message: Brulion is not connected: run brulion-cli clip install.

hostError_disconnected.message: The connection to Brulion ended before the clip was saved.

hostError_no_vault.message: No notebook yet: open one in Brulion first.

hostError_vault_missing.message: The notebook's folder does not exist.

hostError_unknown_notebook.message: This notebook is not among Brulion's notebooks.

hostError_page_not_found.message: The page is not in the notebook.

hostError_under_not_found.message: The page has no such heading.

hostError_lock_timeout.message: The notebook is busy: try again in a moment.

hostError_template_not_found.message: The template page is not in the notebook.

hostError_unknown_template.message: Brulion does not know this template.

hostError_too_large.message: The page is too large to clip.

hostError_empty_clip.message: The template left nothing to save.

hostError_no_app.message: Brulion's app is not installed next to brulion-cli.

hostError_app_not_started.message: Brulion's app could not be started.

hostError_app_not_reached.message: The running Brulion did not answer.

hostError_invalid_utf8.message: The page is not valid UTF-8 text: Brulion leaves it as it is.

templateBlockLabel.message: Template in the journal or under a heading

customHelp.message: Templates kept in this browser. Pages of the notebook's templates folder are offered too.

varTitle.message: the title (of the clip and of the new page)

varSite.message: the site's name, the address's host

varPublished.message: the publication date (yyyy-MM-dd, or your own format)

varContent.message: what was clipped as Markdown; as a quote; as plain text

varTags.message: the tags: #a #b in the text, a list in the frontmatter

varDate.message: the date and time of the clip, as in Brulion's templates
